weighting: exp(-ln(2) * age_days / 180); origin=max(each fold train date)
classification_rule: SUPPORTED if a fixed blend improves pooled WAPE, improves at least two folds, and no nonzero-target route worsens by more than 0.01 absolute WAPE; REJECTED if no fixed blend improves pooled WAPE; otherwise MIXED
reference_checks: Exact fold and per-route absolute errors reproduce prior weighted D results
